verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Fieldwork page says you can describe a control and its AI agents will collect, validate, and package evidence, which is a form of delegating tasks to a first-party AI agent. However, it is a single marketing claim and doesn't clearly show a general-purpose assistant inside the Oneleet product. The MCP and service-key docs only cover connecting external assistants, so they don't count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of an in-product assistant interface, the range of tasks it can take on, how Fieldwork fits into the core Oneleet platform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
